nativeSubmission.correspondence: Worker revision evidence attached to the exact native snapshot publication; native renderer report.frame equals that same snapshot.frame after successful swapchain submission.

limitations: GPU bytes are preserved native upload observations at each actual submission, not GPU readback. Cached shadow draws retain their original submission identity.
This is a native dynamic-asset publication benchmark; replacement assets and typed arrays are explicitly counted, even when actual GPU buffers are reused.
No engine changes, appearance retuning, new dependencies or geometry re-authoring.

observations.resourceCounterDefinition: Observed successful createBuffer/createTexture calls and explicit destroy() calls since pre-boot installation. These are not GPU-memory measurements; resources reclaimed without explicit destroy are not inferred.
